description:
Welcome to Sedithion, a magical place where dragons, faeries, and demons coexist in peace. It’s also the home of Creserua, the “Twilight Dragon” and the only daughter of the Dragon Lord. Despite this impressive title, Creserua’s physical strength and mana are amongst the weakest of her race. She may not be completely content, but at least her pharmacological talents let her excel above her peers. She’s only just reconciled with the idea that nothing will change for a dragon as weak as herself, until one day...she wakes up next to three familiar figures. Her childhood friend, a faerie she’s grown estranged from, and her demon co-researcher. Not only that, but she’s pregnant with no idea who the father is!

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: This series originally released as a R15 version but rereleased as a R19 version in 2024 after the series completed. The R15 version is completed with 80 chapters while the R19 version is completed with 107 chapters.*
